groupings.title: Using Mailworker
groupings.description: Send and receive real email from an agent or a test — throwaway inboxes, blocking on the verification email, and outbound mail through policy gates.

groupings.title: Running your own deployment
groupings.description: Provisioning Mailworker into a Cloudflare account and shipping changes to it. Only useful if you are self-hosting it, which everyone using it is.

groupings.title: Cloudflare
groupings.description: Cloudflare's own published skills, vendored so a fresh clone can deploy without hunting them down. Their work, not this project's.
